userStories.title: Core Shortcut Engine: Physical Key Normalization & Matcher

Modifier-only keys (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta) and bare typing keys are rejected
Lock keys (CapsLock, NumLock, ScrollLock) cannot be bound alone
Canonical combo formatting produces standard order: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Meta+Key
